notes.title: Price Adjustment For Better
notes.content:
Based on the feedback we decided to decrease the regular price from 3.99 $ to 1.99 $ for more convenience as our game is still in early access. 


Stay tune for next update!

notes.title: BadBee Available To Play On Early Access Steam Now
notes.content:
After taking nearly two months to prepare for early access on Steam, you can enjoy playing BadBee today with 15 levels temporarily and more levels will be added to future updates. This game can be played for PC / Mac users with the lowest specifications. Also this game have four different languages such as Bahasa, Chinese, Russian, Vietnamese beside English.

If you can't wait you can try now
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1306900/BadBee/

Also we have official discord to discuss about BadBee and our other products 

https://discord.gg/MpjHv7u

More Info: https://bayamsoftware.com/2020/07/you-can-play-badbee-on-steam-as-early-access-now/

notes.title: Devlog: Sneak Peak About Badbee PC Edition Gameplay
notes.content:
After getting some feedback for the first BadBee gameplay trailer which said it looks easy gameplay, then we decided to release the latest sneak peak video gameplay only on stages 1-10. Understandably all can not be disclosed because it is still under development.

Read more on [url=https://bayamsoftware.com/2020/06/sneak-peak-about-badbee-pc-edition-gameplay/?utm_source=news&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=steam]our official blog[/url]

notes.title: BadBee PC Edition Will Available Next Month
notes.content:
It will be available on Steam on June 26, 2020 in the early access phase at a price of $ 3.99 and will be different if released when full release later. If interested, you can add it to your Steam account wishlist now

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1306900/BadBee/

More info: [url=https://bayamsoftware.com/2020/05/badbee-pc-edition-will-be-available-on-steam-store-next-month/?utm_source=steamcommunity&utm_medium=forum&utm_campaign=badbee]Bayam Software Blog[/url]
